plain_statement: Is there a circuit of AND, OR and NOT gates of fan-in at most two, every gate counted, with at most 14 gates, computing the function true exactly when both ends of some edge are true, for the theta graph joining 0 and 1 by paths 0-2-3-1, 0-4-5-6-1, 0-7-8-9-1 (the term lists the edges; maximum degree 3, every cycle of length at least 7, cover number 5)? The negation, wrapped whole, of the at-least-15 statement. Conjecture that none exists.
title: Search: a fan-in-two AND/OR/NOT circuit of at most 14 gates for the theta graph joining 0 and 1 by paths 0-2-3-1, 0-4-5-6-1, 0-7-8-9-1
